baseline_models.focus_anchor: حمٓ as two separately sounded letter names in a standalone, rootless ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: With no lexical syntax to parse, the ayah shifts the first act from extracting a proposition to voicing discrete signs and attending to their arrival.

changed_reading.before: An opaque label placed before the message.
changed_reading.after: A performative threshold in which sounding and attending precede lexical understanding.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The visible sequence ح then م, without a rooted morpheme or clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two bare graphemes foreground the elemental material from which rooted words and sentences can be assembled while withholding any fixed expansion.

changed_reading.before: An abbreviation whose missing phrase should be guessed.
changed_reading.after: Underdetermined alphabetic material whose exposed form is meaningful before any supplied lexical decoding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bare sound-pair becomes the threshold of a controlled material sequence: conveyed descent, letters joined as writing, parts differentiated, the result voiced as recitation, and meaning made linguistically explicit.

activation_trace.role: Conveyed descent supplies the movement by which an unexplained opening sound arrives as discourse.
Ordered letters and the written product turn the isolated pair into the pre-compositional edge of a book.
Differentiation into disclosed parts and meanings expands the compressed opener without pretending to decode it.
Voiced reading makes the opener's acoustic performance continuous with the recited book.
Explicit expression provides the articulated endpoint against which the opener's initial underdetermination can function.

structural_cues: The standalone rootless ayah is immediately followed by a nominal descent formula and then by a book described through detail, recitation, and linguistic explicitness.
The sequence expands from two bare signs into an articulated textual whole without ever assigning the signs a lexical gloss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, writing, differentiation, recitation, and explicitness; I infer a condensation-to-articulation arrow from 41:1 into 41:2-3. A live alternative is that the opener is an independent marker beside, rather than the first stage of, this chain.

changed_reading.before: A mysterious item before revelation begins.
changed_reading.after: The compressed acoustic edge from which the surah stages revelation as descent, composition, differentiation, and recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the opener offers a minimal audible event before explanation, the surah's sequence of failed hearing, blocked access, deliberate counter-noise, and distance makes reception prior to interpretation diagnostically central.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and response turns the sounded opener into a test of uptake rather than bare audibility.
Blocked access locates failure between signal and receiver, before any lexical solution to the opener.
The explicit refusal of auditory contact confirms that reception itself is being contested.
Mixed counter-noise supplies an active mechanism for drowning the recited signal before it can become intelligible.
A voice attenuated by range and distance culminates the model of a signal rendered inaccessible by the receiver's position.

structural_cues: The reception sequence progresses from not hearing, to an asserted barrier, to organized noise against the recitation, and finally to the image of being called from far away.
The focus ayah's lack of lexical content makes the hearer's stance visible before propositional agreement or disagreement can dominate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies auditory uptake, obstruction, counter-noise, and distance; I infer that the minimal opening sound exposes receptivity before argument begins. The live alternative is that these later scenes concern the recitation generally and do not specially characterize 41:1.

changed_reading.before: Sound before meaning is only a formal peculiarity.
changed_reading.after: Sound before meaning is a reception stress test: refusal can occur at the threshold, before semantic dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opener's unresolved signhood is not repaired by an internal expansion; it is placed at the start of a surah-long disclosure process in which signs recur across text, world, and self until correspondence with truth becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signs classify the detailed textual units that unfold immediately after the bare opening unit.
Manifest signs distributed across outer and inner fields relocate resolution beyond the opener itself.
Emergence into visibility supplies the delayed transition from initial opacity to disclosure.
Stable correspondence with reality gives the disclosure process an evidential endpoint rather than a guessed abbreviation.

structural_cues: References to signs recur from the detailed textual signs near the opening through cosmic and terrestrial signs to signs in horizons and selves near the close.
The late purpose clause is eventual clarification, while no verse supplies a lexical expansion for the focus letters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an initially rootless unit, recurring signs, and eventual clarification as truth; I infer temporal deferral, with 41:1 opening an evidence process rather than encoding a recoverable phrase. The live alternative is that 41:53 verifies the revelation generally without making the opener itself part of that process.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a local riddle that should resolve inside itself.
changed_reading.after: The opening is an unresolved first sign whose intelligibility is distributed forward across textual, cosmic, and inward evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps bodily and cosmic testimony back onto alphabetic matter. It remains anchored in the focus's actually sounded graphemes and in the surah's repeated animation of things not ordinarily treated as speakers, but downstream prose should present it only as a formal-performative analogy, never as a claim that the letters literally testify.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus consists solely of visible marks made vocal, with no lexical speaker or proposition.

activation_trace.role: Uttered command and reply give cosmic matter a speech exchange, widening what can bear a voice.
The body's outer covering becomes part of the witnessing apparatus, supplying a material surface that can carry disclosure.
Testimony grounded in knowledge turns bodily material from passive object into declarative evidence.
Caused, signifying speech supplies the activation by which otherwise mute material can disclose.

changed_reading.before: Two inert letter shapes awaiting a speaker's explanation.
changed_reading.after: A first instance of matter made vocal, anticipating a world and body whose surfaces are later made to disclose.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows an exact consonantal pair across unrelated roots and then uses its reversal in the final word. It remains formally anchored by the focus's adjacent ح-م, two later same-order lexical embeddings, and the terminal م-ح onset with an encompassing branch; downstream prose must call this a whole-surah graphic-phonetic resonance, not shared etymology, lexical decoding, or proof of design.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus exposes adjacent ح-م in that order as a complete ayah.

activation_trace.role: A rooted adjective begins with the exact focus sequence and places that material pair inside intimate nearness.
The same initial pair enters a different rooted adjective of praiseworthiness at the close of the surah's repeated descent formula.
The last word begins with the reversed pair م-ح and contributes complete cognitive enclosure, giving the formal reversal a terminal framing role.

changed_reading.before: An isolated pair with no lexical assignment.
changed_reading.after: A bare pair later embedded in divergent words and finally reversed at the onset of the enclosing last word, forming a tentative material ring from aperture to closure.

strongest_changes: The immediate context turns the rootless sound-pair into the compressed threshold of a descent-to-articulation sequence.
The whole-surah hearing, barrier, noise, and distance sequence makes reception of the opening sound more central than immediate decoding.
The late signs-and-clarification sequence distributes resolution across text, world, and self rather than supplying a lexical expansion.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context preserved a strong reception-and-disclosure reading while also exposing two containable formal outliers: mute material made vocal, and the ح-م pair entering later rooted words before reversing at the onset of the final encompassing word.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supplies no lexical expansion or etymology for the rootless focus.
The reception and disclosure arcs may characterize the recitation as a whole rather than 41:1 specifically.
The consonantal enclosure pattern may be coincidental and should remain exploratory.
